issues: Flat light-grey background with a 150px heavy black 'BREATHE': the heavy weight fights the quiet, breathing mood, and a debug title sits in the corner
The expansion uses a strong ease-out (poly5), so the letters pop apart with no breathing rise and fall
The 32px tertiary-grey subtitle is nearly invisible; the frame contains nothing but one word
After expanding, 72f of total stillness: a dead hold
changes: Switched to the aurora look (violet night, pink-violet horizon); the hero is now 'AFTERGLOW' at 156px / 300 weight with 0.34em final tracking, the quiet thin-and-wide film-title voice
Rhythm is now inhale then exhale: 0–10f the clump tightens further (anticipation), then a 66f slow-in long-tail expansion (−0.42em to 0.34em) with blur 16 to 0 and glow on the same curve

The horizon light band width and the hairline under the word are bound to the same p and exhale with the letters; the hold adds 1.5% extra tracking drift, a breathing band and a 1.5% push, alive without jitter
Added hierarchy: a mono eyebrow 'CHAPTER III' with tightening tracking and a 40px subline revealed word by word with blur; frame 0 is a glowing defocused clump
